name: weighted stability ball crunch (full range)
description: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.
